column1: # REGRESSION-PIN only (spec §4.8 AS-9, AS-11): the UNIKERN1 kernels the canonical route produced
# when this file was written. A pin detects change; it is never an oracle and never proves that a
# byte is right. Correctness comes from x86_64.tsv, arm64.tsv, object.tsv, link.tsv and the
# test-side AS-7/AS-8 recomputation. The same SHA was observed in the stored generations named
# in "observed" (local out/ directories; absent on other hosts, where only the SHA applies).
# 2026-11-06: re-pinned after SBLOAD entered the kernel input (KERNEL-DRIFT): values from
# tools/kernel-route.cx run on exec/c/asm, equal byte-for-byte to the installed package kernels
# (tests/check-kernel-base.cx first-difference=-1); no stored generation is kept, so observed is "-".
